headline: Linn Mercy Sees Fresh Turns on Active Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, the sharpest change is at Linn Mercy: five base events have been logged in two hours, amid 13 in 24, with captures by both factions and neutralizations; its tally remains 8 Colonial, 2 Warden and 1 unheld. Kuura Strand has recorded one event in the same two-hour span, bringing its 24-hour count to 10. Weathered Expanse, still heavily contested with 6 Warden, 1 Colonial and 2 unheld bases, has one fresh event in two hours and 18 in six; casualties and enlistments have picked up in the latest two-hour comparison. Nevish Line retains the largest daily turnover count, 56, but no event in two hours. Marban Hollow and Mooring County are also without fresh two-hour turnover, despite recent activity and substantial fighting. Godcrofts’ Argosa burst is likewise absent from the latest two-hour ledger. Elsewhere, base records are mostly quiet. War 140 remains undecided, with 34 victory towns required.
